products.name: Affordable Housing and Tax Credit Investments
products.description: Origination, syndication, and management of investments in affordable housing and similar projects that qualify for tax credits, acting as general partner or managing member in investment vehicles, with oversight and compliance services provided throughout the investment period.

products.name: Corporate and Retail Banking Services

products.name: Construction and Development Lending
products.description: Origination of loans for residential and commercial construction, including speculative and custom construction, land acquisition, and development. These loans require physical property inspections, regulated underwriting, and are managed by a specialized construction lending team.

products.name: Consumer Lending
products.description: Origination of consumer loans, primarily indirect home improvement (fixture secured) loans through a network of contractors and dealers, as well as marine loans and other consumer credit products. Loans are originated digitally and through partners, secured by personal property, and require credit analysis and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Commercial Business Lending
products.description: Origination of loans and lines of credit to small- and mid-sized businesses, secured by business assets such as accounts receivable, inventory, equipment, and real estate. products.name: Deposit Services
products.description: Provision of a broad range of deposit products to retail and business customers, including checking, savings, money market accounts, and certificates of deposit. Services are delivered through physical branches and digital channels, requiring regulated infrastructure and customer service operations.

products.name: Loan Servicing
products.description: Servicing of residential mortgage loans sold to investors, including collection of payments, escrow management, and customer support. Requires regulated infrastructure, digital servicing platforms, and compliance with investor and regulatory standards.

products.name: Multikine Immunotherapy
products.description: A proprietary biological immunotherapy comprised of a mixture of natural cytokines and small biological molecules, manufactured in CEL-SCI’s dedicated facility, and administered by local injection as a first-line, pre-surgical treatment for newly diagnosed, resectable, locally advanced head and neck cancer patients with low PD-L1 tumor expression. Delivery requires complex biologics manufacturing and regulated clinical administration.

products.name: LEAPS (Ligand Epitope Antigen Presentation System) Technology
products.description: A patented T-cell modulation platform with several preclinical product candidates, including CEL-2000, CEL-4000, and CEL-5000, under development as potential immunotherapies for rheumatoid arthritis and other diseases. These are peptide-based biologics produced using proprietary conjugation methods, currently in animal and in vitro studies, not yet approved for human use.

products.name: Zinc-based Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS)
products.description: Turnkey battery energy storage systems using proprietary zinc-based chemistry, designed, manufactured, and delivered for utility-scale, microgrid, and commercial and industrial applications. These systems are physically manufactured in the U.S. and delivered as modular, scalable solutions for long-duration energy storage.

products.name: Battery Management System (BMS)
products.description: Proprietary software and hardware platform that enables remote asset monitoring, analytics, and predictive maintenance for the company’s BESS products. Delivered as an integrated digital solution with the physical battery systems.

products.name: Project Management, Commissioning, and Maintenance Services
products.description: Professional services including project management for installation and integration, commissioning to verify performance, and long-term maintenance programs to support optimal operation of battery systems. Delivered through in-person human labor and technical expertise.

products.name: DawnOS Energy Storage Software Platform
products.description: Integrated software platform designed to manage, control, and optimize the operation of BESS, providing real-time balancing, dynamic switching, and automation for large-scale battery deployments. Delivered as embedded software within the company’s hardware systems.

products.name: Eos Indensity Energy Storage Architecture
products.description: Modular, high-density energy storage architecture combining Z3 battery modules and DawnOS controls, designed for deployment in space-constrained or traditional sites, including data centers and critical infrastructure. products.name: Seismic Data Acquisition Services

products.description: Digital SaaS platform (Vidello) for hosting, managing, and marketing video content, offering customizable players, interactive features, analytics, and integrations with marketing tools. Delivered as a cloud-based service.

products.name: Commercial Lending
products.description: Provides a variety of loans to businesses and professional service firms, including seasonal loans, bridge loans, term loans, and commercial lines of credit. These are typically collateralized by business assets and require in-person underwriting and ongoing risk management.

products.name: Commercial Real Estate Lending
products.description: Offers loans for both owner-occupied and non-owner-occupied commercial real estate, including office, industrial, retail, hotel, and multifamily properties. These loans are physically underwritten, require collateral, and are subject to regulatory and internal risk management.

products.name: Residential Mortgage Lending
products.description: Provides loans for 1-4 family residential properties, including traditional mortgages, second mortgages, and residential construction loans. Most fixed-rate loans are sold in the secondary market. Origination and servicing require regulatory compliance and physical underwriting.

products.name: Construction and Development Lending
products.description: Offers loans for construction and development projects, both pre-sold and speculative, for residential and commercial properties. These loans are physically monitored and disbursed based on construction progress and inspections.

products.name: Consumer Lending
products.description: Provides loans to retail customers, including home equity loans, vehicle financing, loans secured by deposits, and secured and unsecured personal loans. These are underwritten based on consumer creditworthiness and collateral.

products.name: Deposit Services
products.description: Accepts deposits from individuals and businesses, offering checking accounts, money market accounts, savings accounts, certificates of deposit, and IRAs. Services are delivered through physical branches and digital channels, and deposits are FDIC-insured.

products.name: Electronic Banking Services
products.description: Provides digital banking services such as online and mobile banking, remote deposit capture, 24-hour telephone banking, and participation in ATM and debit card networks. These services are delivered digitally and support both consumer and business customers.

products.name: Treasury and Cash Management Services
products.description: Delivers treasury and cash management solutions to business customers, including account management, funds transfer, and liquidity solutions. These services are provided through a combination of digital platforms and in-person support.

products.name: Correspondent Banking Services
products.description: Provides banking services to other financial institutions, such as clearing, settlement, and liquidity management. These services require regulated infrastructure and are delivered through both digital and traditional channels.

products.name: Investment Securities Sales
products.description: Offers investment products, primarily mortgage-backed securities and state and municipal securities, to customers. These are traded in liquid markets and require financial expertise and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Credit Card Services
products.description: Issues Visa® credit cards and provides related credit card arrangements to customers. This service is delivered through partnerships with card networks and requires digital infrastructure and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Recycled Consumer Electronic Devices
products.description: The company sources pre-owned consumer electronic devices, primarily smartphones and tablets, inspects and refurbishes them to high 'Like-New' quality, and sells them to wholesale customers globally. The process involves physical handling, quality inspection, and refurbishment before distribution.

products.name: B2B Marketplace Platform for Recycled Consumer Electronics
products.description: The company is developing a digital B2B marketplace platform, powered by cloud computing and big data, to connect manufacturers and distributors of recycled consumer electronic devices directly with business buyers, supplementing its traditional wholesale model. This is a digital-only service offering.

products.name: Commercial Lending
products.description: Provides commercial real estate (CRE) and commercial and industrial (C&I) loans to businesses, non-profits, and municipalities, including working capital, equipment financing, and construction loans. These loans are originated and serviced by in-person banking staff and require significant underwriting, collateral evaluation, and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Residential Mortgage Lending
products.description: Originates and services residential real estate loans, including mortgages and homeowner construction loans for one- to four-family properties, both for the bank's portfolio and for sale to the secondary market. Delivered through commissioned mortgage originators and specialized mortgage banking subsidiaries, requiring regulatory licensing and compliance.

products.name: Consumer Lending
products.description: Offers consumer loans such as home equity loans, home equity lines of credit, and personal installment loans to individuals. These are delivered through branch networks and require in-person or digital application, underwriting, and servicing.

products.name: Deposit Services
products.description: Provides a wide range of deposit products to consumer, commercial, non-profit, and municipal customers, including checking, savings, money market, time deposits, and retirement accounts. Delivered through physical branches, ATMs, and digital banking platforms, and includes related services such as debit cards, remote deposit capture, and treasury management.

products.name: Wealth Management and Trust Services
products.description: Provides investment management, financial planning, personal trust and estate services, and institutional trust and custody services to individuals and institutions. Delivered through specialized staff and a registered investment adviser subsidiary, requiring fiduciary expertise and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Specialty Building Products
products.description: A broad range of higher-margin building materials including engineered wood products, siding, millwork, outdoor living products, specialty lumber and panels, and industrial products, sourced from manufacturers and distributed through a national warehouse and logistics network.

products.name: Structural Building Products
products.description: Commodity construction materials such as lumber, plywood, oriented strand board, rebar, remesh, and other wood products primarily used for structural support in residential and commercial construction, distributed via warehouse, reload, and direct channels.

products.name: Value-Added Distribution and Logistics Services
products.description: A suite of services for customers and suppliers including less-than-truckload and job site delivery, inventory stocking, intermodal distribution, milling and fabrication, EWP design, take-off services, and automated order processing, leveraging the company’s logistics infrastructure and technology.

products.name: Residential Mortgage Lending
products.description: Origination of loans for the acquisition or refinance of one- to four-family residences, including both fixed-rate and adjustable-rate mortgages, with some loans held in portfolio and others sold on the secondary market. Requires in-person and online application processing, underwriting, and compliance with regulatory standards.

products.name: Multi-Family Residential Lending
products.description: Origination of loans secured by multi-family residential properties, often with amortization up to 25 years and balloon maturities, including both fixed and adjustable rates. Involves underwriting, appraisal, and risk management for income-producing properties.

products.name: Commercial Real Estate Lending
products.description: Origination of loans secured by commercial real estate, including farmland, retail, hospitality, healthcare, and other business properties. Loans typically have amortization up to 25 years, may be fixed or variable rate, and require significant underwriting and collateral evaluation.

products.name: Construction Lending
products.description: Origination of loans for construction or development of residential and commercial properties, including land development. Loans are typically interest-only during construction and may convert to permanent financing. Involves project appraisal, monitoring, and risk management.

products.name: Commercial Business Lending
products.description: Provision of loans to businesses for purposes such as financing accounts receivable, inventory, equipment, and operating lines of credit. Includes both fixed and adjustable rate loans, with underwriting based on business cash flow and collateral.

products.name: Consumer Lending
products.description: Offering of secured consumer loans, including home equity, automobile, second mortgage, mobile home, and deposit-secured loans, primarily to customers in the bank’s market area. Includes both fixed-rate and variable-rate products such as home equity lines of credit.

products.name: Deposit Services
products.description: Provision of a broad selection of deposit instruments to retail and business customers, including checking, savings, money market, and certificates of deposit, as well as retirement savings plans. Delivered through branch network, online, and mobile channels.

products.name: Bank Card and Payment Services
products.description: Provision of bank card services, including debit cards and related payment processing, as well as bank card interchange fees. Includes support for ATM, online, and mobile transactions.

products.name: Investment Securities Sales
products.description: Investment of funds in securities such as mortgage-backed securities, U.S. Government Agency obligations, municipal bonds, and other permissible investments. These are held for the bank’s own account and not sold to customers, but generate interest income.

products.name: Insurance Brokerage Services
products.description: Brokerage of commercial and consumer insurance products through a subsidiary, Southern Insurance Services, LLC. Involves acting as an intermediary for insurance policies for customers.

products.name: Pipe, Valves, and Fittings (PVF) Distribution
products.description: Distribution of a broad range of steel, fiberglass, and composite pipes, valves, and fittings for use in energy and industrial applications. Products are sourced from manufacturers and stocked in regional centers for rapid delivery to customers globally.

products.name: Pumps, Production and Process Solutions
products.description: Provision and fabrication of pumps, rotating equipment, and engineered process and production equipment, including modular wellsite facilities, LACT units, separators, and vapor recovery systems. Includes assembly, testing, and field services for oil, gas, water, and industrial applications.

products.name: Gas Distribution Products
products.description: Distribution of gas utility products such as risers, meters, polyethylene pipe and fittings, and related components for the storage and distribution of natural gas to residential and commercial customers. Products are sourced, stocked, and delivered to gas utilities and related sectors.

products.name: Valve Automation and Modification Services
products.description: Provision of valve automation, modification, and engineering services, including assembly of actuators, welding, hydrotesting, painting, coating, and custom valve solutions to meet customer specifications. Delivered through specialized engineering centers and field teams.

products.name: Measurement, Instrumentation, and Control Products
products.description: Distribution of measurement, instrumentation, and automation products, including flow meters, control valves, and related systems for process control and monitoring in energy and industrial facilities. Includes technical support and integration services.

products.name: Fittings, Flanges, and Connectors
products.description: Distribution of metal and composite fittings, flanges, and connectors used to join piping and valve systems for the transmission of liquids and gases. Products are stocked in various metallurgies and sizes to meet diverse customer needs.

products.name: General and Oilfield Supplies
products.description: Distribution of general industrial and oilfield supplies, including mill, tool, safety, electrical supplies, and completion equipment. Products support maintenance, repair, and operations (MRO) across energy and industrial sectors.

products.name: Integrated Supply Chain and Materials Management Solutions
products.description: Provision of outsourced procurement, warehouse, and inventory management services, including digital catalog integration, on-site support, and logistics coordination. Services are delivered through proprietary IT systems and tailored to customer supply chain needs.

products.name: Digital Commerce and E-Commerce Platforms
products.description: Provision of digital platforms (DigitalNOW® and MRCGO™) for online product ordering, tracking, and supply chain integration, enabling customers to manage procurement and inventory digitally. Platforms support self-service, reporting, and workflow automation.

products.name: Aftermarket Field Services and Equipment Rentals
products.description: Provision of field repair, commissioning, and rental services for pumps, compressors, and process equipment. Includes on-site technical support, maintenance, and rental of mobile pumping units and process systems for customer operations.
